entertainment.title: War Is Coming in the ‘Percy Jackson’ Season 3 Trailer
entertainment.summary: The Disney+ show takes a more menacing turn in the season based on 'The Titan's Curse.'
entertainment.body:
Logo text The war between the gods and Titans is starting in season three of Percy Jackson and the Olympians , and as usual, the demigods are caught in the middle.

The trailer for season three of the series takes a notably darker tone than the previous two seasons — both literally (there are quite a few dimly lit shots) and figuratively. The action turns on Annabeth (Leah Sava Jeffries) being abducted and Percy (Walker Scobell) going on a quest to rescue her. In order to do that, “he must free a goddess in chains, confront the Titan’s curse, and avoid triggering the fall of Olympus,” the season’s logline reads. “With Grover (Aryan Simhadri) by his side, Percy must join some unlikely questmates to confront a prophecy with dire consequences.” Watch the trailer below. Related Stories Movies 'Fair Play' Doc About Olympic Gymnast Jordan Chiles Set for 2027 Release on Hulu, Disney+ (Exclusive) TV Lea Michele in Talks for 'Glee' Return in Disney+/Hulu Revival

Charlie Bushnell and Tamara Smart also star in season three, continuing their roles as Luke and Thalia. Levi Chrisopulos joins the regular cast as fan favorite character Nico di Angelo; Dior Goodjohn (Clarisse La Rue), Daniel Diemer (Tyson), Glynn Turman (Chiron), Courtney B. Vance (Zeus), Jason Mantzoukas (Dionysus), Beatrice Kitsos (Allison Simms) and Kevin Chacon (Chris Rodriguez) also return.

New to the show for season three are Olive Abercrombie as Nico’s older sister Bianca, Dafne Keen as Artemis, Saara Chaudry as Artemis’ liuetenant Zoë Nightshade, Jesse L. Martin as Frederick Chase, Holt McCallany as Atlas, David Costabile as Dr. Thorn, Kate McKinnon as Aphrodite, Ming-Na Wen as Hera, Jennifer Beals as Demeter and Hubert Smielecki as Apollo.

Percy Jackson author Rick Riordan and Jonathan E. Steinberg created the series and executive produce season three with Dan Shotz, Craig Silverstein, Rebecca Riordan, The Gotham Group’s Ellen Goldsmith-Vein and Jeremy Bell, Bert Salke, James Bobin, Jim Rowe, Albert Kim, Sarah Watson and Tamara Becher-Wilkinson. Jet Wilkinson is an EP on the final two episodes of the season.

Percy Jackson and the Olympians premieres Nov. 20 on Disney+ and will stream two episodes a week for four weeks.

entertainment.title: Olivia Rodrigo Announces First-Ever Christmas Song ‘Take Me Home’: Here’s When It Arrives
entertainment.summary: The star dons a Santa hat and red lipstick on the single's artwork.
entertainment.body:
Olivia Rodrigo fans are getting an early Christmas present this year, with the pop star gifting them her first-ever holiday song in just a few days.

As revealed on Monday (Nov. 2), Rodrigo will release “Take Me Home (4 Christmas)” at 8 p.m. ET on Thursday (Nov. 5). The Grammy winner shared the news on Instagram, premiering the single’s artwork: a photo of Rodrigo sitting on the floor in a red Santa hat and matching lipstick.

“my first Christmas song “take me home (4 christmas)” is out this Thursday at 5 pm pt/ 8 pm ET!! you can preorder it now. im so excited!!!” she wrote in the caption.

The offering comes after an already packed year for Rodrigo, who dropped her third studio album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love in June. The project spawned Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 single “Drop Dead” and has spent three weeks total atop the Billboard 200 .

In August, the former Disney star successfully launched her Daisy Chain Fields festival, raising $20 million for women’s charities before embarking on her Unraveled arena tour the following month. She then enlisted longtime pal Chappell Roan for a surprise remix of “Expectations” in October propelling the song to No. 3 on the Hot 100.

Now, as the calendar switches from Halloween season to November, Rodrigo is throwing her hat into the holiday song market, which is dominated each year by Mariah Carey’s perennial smash “All I Want for Christmas Is You.” (The Songbird Supreme gave her annual “It’s time!” announcement on the first day of the month.) The “Drivers License” artist is far from the only star unwrapping fresh X-mas music this year, with Hilary Duff recently dropping a holiday EP and Alanis Morissette gearing up to release holiday LP Good Weather for Immaculate Conception .

entertainment.title: Like, Subscribe, Graduate: Emerson College Launching Content Creation Major (Exclusive)
entertainment.summary: The Boston-based college will launch its new B.A. degree in the fall of 2027 to help students learn the ins and outs of the creator economy.
entertainment.body:
Communications students matriculating into Emerson College next year will have an entirely new major to choose from: A bachelor of arts in content creation. The Hollywood Reporter has learned that the Boston-based college will launch the new degree program in the fall of 2027.

The new degree underscores the rapidly changing dynamics of media, with creator-led platforms like YouTube, TikTok and Instagram continuing to grow at a rapid clip even as traditional film and TV production and distribution seems to be flat or declining.

The new major will pull from the school’s existing infrastructure and expertise in areas like storytelling, production and communications while incorporating creator-focused areas of study like marketing, audience development, branding and business strategy, given the owner-operator nature of the creator world. Students will develop original content while studying the business and ethics of digital platforms, while also learning how to reach and engage audiences.

“Emerson has long prepared students for success in emerging creative industries with a focus on hands-on, real world application in our academic disciplines and now this new major builds on our tradition by combining creativity, technology and entrepreneurial skills for the next generation,” said Emerson president Jay Bernhardt.

Emerson, which is among THR’s 25 best film schools of 2026, has an envious alumni list that includes former Warner Bros. film co-chief Pamela Abdy, filmmakers Daniel Kwan and Paul Thomas Anderson, writer Norman Lear and actors like Henry Winkler and Jennifer Coolidge.

The bachelor of arts in content creation will be housed in Emerson College’s School of Communication, within the department of strategic marketing and business.

“Our new content creation major prepares students to be a part of the evolving creator economy , teaching them not only how to produce compelling digital content but also how to build a successful entrepreneurial career,” said Brenna McCormick, chair of the department of strategic marketing and business. “From digital and financial literacy to business and marketing, this major has the essential ingredients to help students turn their creative visions into something bigger.”

entertainment.title: Indigenous Documentary ‘Ceremony’ Lands at Netflix
entertainment.summary: Canadian director Bianchi Hanuse’s film that debuted at SXSW will launch on the streamer in 2027.
entertainment.body:
Netflix has nabbed the Indigenous feature documentary Ceremony after a SXSW world premiere.

Director Bianchi Hanuse’s film will land on the streamer in 2027 after winning awards at SXSW, Hot Docs and the Sydney Film Festival. Ceremony centers on British Columbia’s Nuxalk Nation as it looks to restore the local population of ooligan fish, whose arrival every spring sustains the First Nations community and its ritual celebrations.

The restoration efforts, including broadcasts from the Nuxalk Radio station, also underline the resilience of the Indigenous community in the face of challenges from climate change and colonialization. “Nuxalkmc [Nuxalk people] asked for this story to be told and that responsibility took 12 years because our truth isn’t an easy one to tell. It’s a story most Canadians have never heard. We made it for us and with Netflix, we’re sharing it beyond our valley,” director Hanuse said in a statement. Related Stories Movies Netflix Acquires Joel Coen's 'Jack of Spades,' Planning Big Push for Next Oscar Season TV Druski Signs Deal With Netflix, Sets Church Comedy 'Collect & Praise'

In Canada , Netflix has acquired earlier Indigenous-themed or directed content, including the late Jeff Barnaby’s Rhymes for Ghouls , Stephen S. Campanelli’s Indian Horse and Miranda de Pencier’s The Grizzlies . In 2024, Netflix acquired the documentary Yintah, which follows Indigenous activists with the Wet’suwet’en First Nation looking to protect their lands and was directed by Michael Toledano, Jennifer Wickham and Brenda Mitchell.

Netflix also streams the Arctic-set Indigenous comedy North of North , a co-production with the CBC. That ongoing support for Indigenous movies and creators also comes amid calls by local indie producers and other cultural nationalists for Netflix and other U.S. tech giants and foreign players to be subject to the same content expenditure obligations as traditional broadcasters.

Ceremony is written by Hanuse and Jessica Mayhew and is produced by Smayaykila Films.

entertainment.title: Golden Globes: ‘Club Kid’ Submitted as Drama (Exclusive)
entertainment.summary: Many had expected Jordan Firstman's feature directorial debut, about a club promoter who stays too long at the party, to compete in the musical/comedy categories.
entertainment.body:
Club Kid , Jordan Firstman ’s acclaimed film about a club promoter who stays too long at the party, has been submitted by distributor A24 for Golden Globes consideration as a drama, rather than a musical/comedy, The Hollywood Reporter has exclusively learned.

This classification means that the film — which Firstman wrote, directed (as his feature directorial debut) and stars in — will compete in the genre-specific Globes categories (picture, actor and actress) against the likes of The Odyssey , La Bola Negra , Dune: Part Three , Elsinore , All of a Sudden , Fjord and Possible Love , rather than Wild Horse Nine , The Invite , The Debut , Artificial , Obsession , Project Hail Mary and Tender Loving Care . Related Stories General News 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards: 'General Hospital' Wins Best Daytime Drama TV The Hollywood Reporter Wins 2026 Daytime Emmy Award

A24’s decision, which was made in close consultation with Firstman, may come as a surprise to some given Firstman’s background in comedy and the fact that some have described Club Kid as an elevated variation of Big Daddy , the 1999 Adam Sandler comedy about a man who unexpectedly becomes the guardian of a young child.

But Club Kid becomes considerably more dramatic as it progresses, and Firstman — who shines in a decidedly dramatic courtroom scene late in the film — has cited heavier films like 1978’s An Unmarried Woman and 1979’s Kramer vs. Kramer as key inspirations.

Club Kid had its world premiere at the Cannes Film Festival in the Un Certain Regard section, after which it received a seven-minute standing ovation and sparked an overnight bidding war among distributors. The film ultimately sold to A24 for $17 million, making it the biggest sale of the fest. It has since played to raves at the Telluride, Toronto, New York and other film fests. And it will begin a platform theatrical release on Friday.

THR recently broke the news of two other high-profile Globes categorizations: Obsession as a musical/comedy and Artificial as a musical/comedy .

entertainment.title: Designer Rebecca Minkoff Drafts Model and Reality TV Star Grace Ann Nader for Capsule Collection
entertainment.summary: The three-piece collection, which debuts today, features a Grace Ann cropped jacket ($248), a Carson boot ($239) and the "Holland" Nolita hobo ($398).
entertainment.body:
Exactly one year ago, almost to the day, Rebecca Minkoff attended the CFDA Awards at New York’s American Museum of Natural History. The fashion designer hosted Grace Ann Nader as her guest at the glitzy event, which featured a slew of high profile award winners like Ralph Lauren, Thom Browne, The Row’s Ashley and Mary-Kate Olsen, A$AP Rocky, Alaïa’s Pieter Mulier, Donatella Versace, Sara Moonves, Cynthia Rowley and others.

But aside from trophies, something else got carried away from that evening: Minkoff developed a closer friendship with Nader, best known as a model and reality TV personality, that has now produced a capsule collection. Related Stories Movies 'Fair Play' Doc About Olympic Gymnast Jordan Chiles Set for 2027 Release on Hulu, Disney+ (Exclusive) TV Hulu's Rumored Clavicular Doc Is Actually a True-Crime Series (Exclusive)

Today Minkoff introduces Rebecca Minkoff x Grace Ann Nader, a three-piece collection that “blends Rebecca’s signature downtown-cool sensibility with Grace Ann’s free-spirited aesthetic,” per the brand. It’s a limited line that leaves open the possibility for future collaborations down the line.

The capsule collection’s three pieces include a Grace Ann cropped jacket ($248), a black bomber-inspired jacket with a contrasting brown faux-fur collar, a Carson boot ($239) in black suede with ruching and beaded accents, and a “Holland” Nolita hobo ($398), that is named for Nader’s mother. The slouchy genuine-suede leather bag features stud detailing, antique silver hardware and a metal handle.

See Nader and the pieces below. Repped by Ford Models and WME, Nader, who graduated from the University of Georgia and earned a master’s in public health from New York University, is known for teaming with her sisters Brooks, Mary Holland and Sarah Jane in Hulu ‘s Love Thy Nader reality TV series. The series recently wrapped filming on a second season, which is set to premiere early in 2027.
